name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the fully permitted Diablillos project in the Salta province of northwest Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study on Diablillos and is targeting first production in 2029. AbraSilver graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the Toronto Stock Exchange in February 2025 and also trades on the OTCQX under the symbol ABBRF.
